title: Tesla Self Driving vs Everyday Roads!
summary: Marques Brownlee records an uninterrupted drive using Tesla's Full Self Driving beta (v10.69) on ordinary roads. He shows how it handles everyday traffic and where he needs to intervene.
why: HN uses it as a widely seen, fairly balanced real-world appraisal of FSD, both for its impressive moments and for its manual takeovers.

quote.text: this MKBHD video from a few days ago was a fair appraisal of the current state of FSD
